title: An exemption stands only if it cites Akien or there-is-no-other-way — and there are not 187 of them
question: Roughly 187 exemption reasons stand in the corpus that now red under shipped physics. Do they carry standing?
ruling: No. Akien, 2026-09-10: 'there have not been 187 exceptions from me so agree.' An exemption reason CC authored is not a ruling from Akien, so it holds nothing back. They red.
disposition: NO CENSUS AND NO REVIEW. Akien: 'why are we bothering with me having to review 187 exceptions. my ADD brain won't. I allowed less than a dozen. these are all going to be disallowed unless they have a there-is-no-other-way reason.' The default is DISALLOWED and the red is the filter: an exemption stands only if it cites a ruling from Akien or carries a there-is-no-other-way reason. Everything else reds and is fixed. The few that genuinely cannot be fixed surface ONE AT A TIME as they resist fixing, and there will be a handful - which is the only form in which they reach him.
akiens_standing_note: 'i hate when i have a bunch of things to approve, but it's better than shit not working, which is the only alternative.' The census exists to make the approving cheap - one table, one pass - not to make it bigger.
traces_to: Law 9 (red is the default; there is no triage authority)
Law 4 (a rule enforced by physics, not by an exemption field)

measured_after_the_ruling.finding: THE 187 IS A PHANTOM. Direct measurement: ZERO exemption-bearing values in any JSON in class-space; FIVE '"exempt":' occurrences in code, four of them one sieve config ('exempt': ('db_domain',)) exempting db_domain from the import sieve because db_domain IS the door to 5432 - there-is-no-other-way by construction. The 471 strings matching exemption-language are 384 validation-record fields (identity/expected/actual - tooth names and values containing 'skip'/'not applicable') and 54 clearance-gate stamps: noise. What remains is a handful of charter prose, and the sampled ones cite Akien by name (diagnostic_inspector: 'SETTLED, exempted by name when Akien had every other findings-emitter's...').
measured_after_the_ruling.provenance_of_the_error: '~187 exemption reasons that now red' entered the corpus in slate 2026-09-10-tier-1-is-proved-and-an-orient-berth-is-at-akiens-gate as item (g) of open_threads - a bare claim with no address and no measure, carried across a compaction. 187 is also the exact count of history.json entries carrying proven_by, measured the same day; the conflation is the likely origin. Law 3: it was a hypothesis wearing a number.
measured_after_the_ruling.so: Akien's estimate ('i allowed less than a dozen') and the corpus agree. There is no review queue here.

supersedes: The earlier disposition in this file, which asked Akien to review a table of ~187. That table has no subject and building it would have been a chore manufactured from an unmeasured number.
owed_physics: A sieve over the exemption sites: an exemption whose reason cites neither a decision id nor a there-is-no-other-way argument is a red. Same shape as the corrosion tooth (a constraint that stopped constraining carries a ruling). Small - the population is single digits.
